evidence_class: wiring/fixture; no training run, no quality or ship claim

design.abstract_mask: logits hard-masked to M codebook slots + <endabstract>; short logit row fails closed
design.hard_cap: m_max slot tokens, then forced <endabstract> without a forward; recorded as forced_end/abstract_termination=forced_cap
design.fail_closed: malformed/nested abstract delimiters raise AbstractDecodeError in prompt, span, and answer phase; no repair, no full-vocabulary fallback
design.sampling: independent AbstractSamplingParams(temperature, seed) per phase; temperature 0 = greedy
design.telemetry: per-phase token_ids/token_count and per-token logprobs (None for forward-free commits); plan compatibility_fingerprint stamped
design.default_off: CausalLMOpenUIConfig.abstract=None keeps legacy outputs/logits byte-identical; generate_abstract_traced raises unless enabled
